metadata.name: GetLoanPlanSchedule
metadata.description: The Purpose of this API is to get the plan schedule of Equal Payment Plan

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXX Example: 8000000000000110 Condition: At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXX Example:12345 Condition: At least one account identifier is required.

request_fields.name: PlanID
request_fields.description: ID of the plan whose information is required.This API is for Equal Payment Plan only. Valid Values:0-9 Format: xxxx Example:72456

request_fields.name: ScheduleType
request_fields.description: Schedule type of Institution Reports. Valid Values: 0 = Dynamic, 1 = Static Allowable Values: 2

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXX Example:8000000000000110 Allowable Values: 16

children.name: PlanList
children.description: Array for plan details.

children.name: PlanSequence
children.description: It will return plan sequence in array. Valid Values: 0 - 9 Format: xx Example: 1

children.name: PlanID
children.description: ID of the plan. Valid Values: 0 - 9 Format: xxxx Example: 72456

children.name: CurrentBalance
children.description: Current balance of account/Debtor Owing. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXX.XX Example: 500.00

children.name: LoanCreationDate
children.description: Loan Creation Date and Time. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 01/01/2020

children.name: OriginalLoanTerm
children.description: This tag will return the original loan term. Valid Values:0-9 Example: 24

children.name: CurrentTerm
children.description: Current term will be equal to the original loan term till loan is not rescheduled, otherwise it will be different than original loan term. Valid Values:0-9 Example: 24

children.name: OriginalTotalPrincipal
children.description: Principal amount on the statement. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXX.XX Example: 2000.00

children.name: OriginalTotalInterest
children.description: Total Interest charged on account in amount. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXX Example: 369.28

children.name: OriginalEqualPayment
children.description: Equal Amount of Payment which has been identified for the plan. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 86.84

children.name: RevisedEqPmtAfterReschedule
children.description: Revised Equal Amount of Payment which has been identified for the plan. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 100.00

children.name: PrincipalPaidToDate
children.description: Principal considered till date. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XX.XX Example: 1000.00

children.name: InterestPaidToDate
children.description: Total sum of transaction amount for Interest Charged till date. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XX.XX Example: 10.00

children.name: InvoiceID
children.description: Invoice Number for Transaction. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXX Example: 170116014612199

children.name: PlanPaymentList
children.description: PlanPaymentList .

children.name: PaymentNumber
children.description: Defines Number of Installment against the Payment Due date. Valid Values:1-9 Format:  X Example: '7', which indicates 7th Installment for the Payment

children.name: StatementDate
children.description: Statement generation date. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 12/27/2020

children.name: PaymentDueDate
children.description: Due date as to by when payment needs to be made to avoid late fees. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 12/27/2020

children.name: AmountDue
children.description: Total amount due as on statement date. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 86.84

children.name: PrincipalPayment
children.description: Amount of Principal Payment for the Installment Payment Number. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 86.84

children.name: InterestPayment
children.description: Amount of Interest Payment for the Installment Payment Number. Interest Earned by the Loan Provider. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 10.00

children.name: InterestLeftOver
children.description: This tag will return interest left over amount. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 20.00

children.name: ResponseID
children.description: This number indicates that API responded.Response ID is unique. This value will be null if no authentication information was passed.Response ID can be used for tracking. Valid Values:0-9, a-z Format: xxx Example:56886590
